verification: Recomputed all three policies and activity metrics; matched saved results to 1e-12.
selection_disclosure: Five cases curated after observing test outcomes; not a random sample or population success estimate.
product_image_note: Actual local photos when available; otherwise category/name/colour metadata cards, not product photos.
popularity_definition: Rank articles by transaction count in the prior 120-day eligible catalog; ties by article ID. Exposure is weighted by recommendation slots.
long_tail_definition: Items ranked below the top 10% of the eligible catalog by prior transactions.

examples.title: Strong match
examples.selection_rule: At least two hits; at most eight future items; highest hit count then MAP.

examples.title: Partial match
examples.selection_rule: One hit among at least three future items, with a match in the first six ranks.

examples.title: Active customer · miss
examples.selection_rule: At least 50 prior purchases, at most six future items, and no exact match.

examples.title: Low-history match
examples.selection_rule: One or two prior transactions; an exact match; highest MAP.

examples.title: New customer · miss
examples.selection_rule: No recorded prior transactions and no exact match; at most six future items.
